Lord Jannath's Bodyguard is a human barbarian who accompanies her master to the ceremony of ordaining  Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

Involvement

Lord Jannath's Bodyguard is in the mess hall, on the first floor of Wyrm's Rock Fortress. She came with her master,  Lord Raylen Jannath, and while waiting for her lord to descend from Audience Hall, spends time walking back and forth in the mess hall.

If spoken to, she shoos the party away, telling them she is on duty and might be called by her master any moment.

If the party confront Gortash, Lord Jannath's Bodyguard's corpse is with all the other invited guests and their retinue, slaughtered in the Audience hall.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Enraged Throw ()   –  Javelin +1
Damage: 7~12
1d6 + 6⁠Piercing

Pick up an item or creature and throw it at a target, dealing additional damage and knocking it  Prone.

Your Strength affects the additional damage and how much weight you can throw. Heavier items deal more damage.

The damage of weapons with the  Thrown property is the same as the weapon's melee damage.

You also deal additional damage based on your Strength.

Available only when  Frenzied.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Frenzied Strike ()   –  Trident +1
Damage: 7~12
1d6 + 6⁠Piercing

As a bonus action, make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.

Will cause a stack of  Frenzied Strain on the barbarian.

 Range: Normal weapon range
 Recharge: Per turn
 Frenzy ( + )

Your  Rage turns into a frenzy! You gain  Frenzied Strike and  Enraged Throw. You can also make an  Improvised Melee Weapon attack as a bonus action.

Deal 2 extra damage with melee and improvised weapons, and throwing. Gain Resistance to physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.

 Range: Self
 Main Hand Attack ()   –  Trident +1
Damage: 7~12
1d6 + 6⁠Piercing
Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Reckless Attack ()   –  Trident +1
Damage: 7~12
1d6 + 6⁠Piercing
Throw all caution in the wind to gain  Advantage on your melee  Attack Roll.

Until your next turn, you have advantage on attack rolls, but enemies also have advantage on attack rolls against you.

 Range: Normal weapon range
